findings.title: Example 1 is internally impossible as written (test dates and C-2 failure row)
findings.attack: [0099] states forty inflation cycles each with 'a hold of 24 hours', yet 'The test ran from 2026-08-12 to 2026-08-20' (eight days for at least forty days of holds). Table 1 row C-2 records 0.7 bar leak-down at last measured cycle 11 but failure at cycle 12, against the 0.5 bar criterion of [0100]. The only actual example is impeachable, and the error is not correctable after filing because the correct values are not derivable from the text (EPC Rule 139).
findings.least_narrowing_action: Obtain the actual test record from the inventor and correct the dates or hold duration in [0099], [0100] and [0059], and the C-2 row and column headings of Table 1. No claim change.

findings.title: The summary states a sealant-film removal effect that the only data partly contradict
findings.attack: [0007] 'The valves described herein remove sealant film that has already formed' and [0017] 'purge themselves of sealant film' are contradicted by [0103] 'Cured sealant film was present on the outer surface 38 of each seat ring 30 in the region of the purge gap 60', which is a sealant-accumulation surface. An EPO examiner will reformulate the problem as a less ambitious one, and a litigant will attack purge flow as the mechanism.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Recast [0007] and [0017] to state the action (purge flow along the sealant-accumulation surfaces; recovery wipe) and the observation of Example 1, not an unqualified removal result (Corrections 1 and 2).

findings.title: Definitions of 'sealing face' and 'inflatable body' import dependent-claim features into independent claims
findings.attack: [0050] defines 'sealing face' as the surface 'across which the deflectable element slides in the recovery wipe', which by US lexicography imports claim 5 into claims 1, 2 and 4. [0079] defines 'inflatable body' as one that 'contains the sealant', which imports claim 50 into claim 3 and lets a tube supplied dry escape direct infringement.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Limit each definition to what the term is: make the recovery wipe a conditional sentence and the sealant a condition of use (Corrections 5 and 6).

findings.title: 'The valves described herein' statements exclude viable embodiments (added valve, one moving part, whole mechanism in the core)
findings.attack: [0007] 'by the action of one moving part, with no tool, no action by the rider, no stored gas and no valve additional to the valve member' and [0017] 'the whole mechanism is contained in the valve core' are general statements about the invention. They support a US disavowal argument by a competitor who adds a series one-way valve, conflict with claim 1 (no valve core required) and with [0122] (clamping by the valve stem), and are inaccurate on the description's own terms (the deflectable element and biasing member move).
findings.least_narrowing_action: Recast them as statements about the embodiments described and drop 'one moving part' (Corrections 1 and 4).

findings.title: Ranges disclaimed for the polymer seat ring and wiper ring, yet claims 30-34 and 47 depend on those embodiments
findings.attack: [0093] 'are not stated for the polymer seat ring', [0106] 'No dimension is stated for the wiper ring 130' and [0124] 'not stated for the alternatives' deny the ranges for combinations that claims 30-34 (through claims 25-29) and 47 (through claims 44-45) expressly claim. This draws an EPC Art. 84 / 35 U.S.C. 112(a) inconsistency objection, and an opponent will cite the description's own denial.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Ask the inventor whether the pressure, over-travel and purge gap width ranges apply to those embodiments. If yes, amend [0093], [0106], [0124] and [0125]. If no, restrict the dependencies of claims 30-34 and 47 (narrowing, which loses only those combinations).

findings.title: 'Operates as a conventional valve' characterises the claimed normal-stroke behaviour as known
findings.attack: 'in this range the valve operates as a conventional valve' and its variants let an examiner cite the applicant's own words for ranges (a) and (b) and the main flow passage without a reference. The practical effect is small because reference 1 already shows this.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Replace with 'operates without purge flow' (Corrections 3 and 7 to 10).

findings.title: The method summary in [0015] is narrower than claim 4
findings.attack: [0015] 'and removing the inflation device, so that the pressure differential falls' is narrower than claim 4 'ceases to apply pressure to the valve or is removed from it'. Read as 'the invention', it could confine claim 4 to removal of the device.

findings.title: The description contradicts itself on the core body material of the tested prototype
findings.attack: [0028] 'The core body 20 is turned from free-machining brass CW614N in the prototype', with 'prototype' defined in [0090] as the tested units, conflicts with [0132] 'the material of the core body 20 of the valve cores 90 tested in Example 1 ... not recorded herein'. This invites an attack on the accuracy of the record.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Ask the inventor, then either delete the words from [0132] or detach CW614N from the tested units in [0028] and [0067].

findings.title: Background pinpoints use database paragraph indices, not the documents' own numbering
findings.attack: 'at paragraph [13] and at paragraph [6] respectively' (US4050473A, US4236547A), 'at paragraphs [22] and [26]' (US3570510A) and 'at paragraph [10]' (US6053992A) cite paragraphs that do not exist in grants printed with column and line numbering. '[26]' is not the [00NN] form of US20080188352A1. This misstates where the art is found.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Drop the pinpoints and keep the characterisations (Corrections 12 to 17). Counsel can add column-and-line pinpoints from the official documents.

assumptions.text: A1. This reply is a drafting and analysis aid prepared by AI; it is not legal advice or a filing decision, and qualified patent counsel reviews and signs off before anything is filed.
A2. No numeral cross-check was in the package; one was generated with pc registry (49 entries) and pc numerals (0 problems). pc terms against LOCKED.md found 0 violations, 0 drift and 0 warnings.

A3. Common general knowledge: US grants issued before 2001 are printed with column and line numbering and no paragraph numbers; the bracketed indices in prior-art/refs are those of the public database extract.
A4. The EPO problem-solution approach, US lexicography and disavowal, and EPC Rule 139 are stated from general knowledge of patent practice.
A5. F-38-1 assumes each cycle includes the full 24-hour hold of [0099] and that the cycles on one valve core are sequential.
